Hello Speleology!

In the interest of building a better community here, I'm opening up applications for moderators. I'm not expecting anyone to be able to do all of these, although it would be awesome if you:

  1. Are able to monitor the community on a daily basis (or almost daily)
  2. Are able to contribute content at least once a week
  3. Are gifted with the gift of CSS and can prettify our small community
  4. Are a good promoter and can help our community grow
  5. Have additional skills which will be of help to the community

In giving a bit more detail about what I hope the community to become, any potential mods should meet ALL these criteria:

  • You do not censor content.
  • You are not ban-happy.
  • You are respectful and encouraging of users, particularly those less familiar with speleology or caving in general.

Still interested? To apply for the positions give a small intro of yourself below as well as your abilities viz a viz my lists above, as well as any other compelling reasons why you feel you would make a good mod. There is no set amount of people who will be accepted, however ideally I will be promoting 3 or so people to the job. Good luck!

 

~ 5parro

If you had a robotic assistant who could perform all your menial tasks would you do more with your life or less?
Would my gf do more with her life? Probably.

I don't think you would do less with your life. At the very worst, if you spent the extra time that you now have doing literally nothing but otherwise lived the rest of your life exactly the same, you would be doing as much with your life now as you were before having a robotic assistant. I think it'd be essentially guaranteed that, having so much more spare time, that you'd have a happier, more fulfilling lifestyle.

If you didn't have to set aside time everyday to cook, for example, not only would you have an extra ~30+ minutes a day, but you'd also be less inclined to eat fast food as home cooked meals are generally healthier and cheaper.[citation needed] If you didn't have to worry about driving to and from work, there's another ~20-60 minutes of free time to sleep, relax, or do whatever.( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) You wouldn't have to worry about doing laundry, washing the dishes, tending to a lawn, general maintenance... the list goes on. And depending on how advanced this robot was, maybe your groceries could be taken care of, and maybe you wouldn't have to spend so much time doing taxes every year. It might also be able to help with personal and long term finance for those pesky student loans (or maybe the loans you took out to buy this miracle worker in the first place!). You'd be able to spend more time for yourself, whether that means playing games, spending time with others, or even learning new skills and information.

Come to think of it, these robotic assistants sound an awful lot like our parents when we were kids, don't they?

You'd actually do less.

We already have the equivalent of robot assistants in smartphones, facebook, amazon.com, etc. All types of technological advances only serve to pacify and immobilize us. Convenience doesn't help your life grow. It's stifles it.

Just picture going to a gym and having people on either side of you lifting your weights for you. Does it make your muscles grow or atrophy?

Consider how facebook claims to keep you in touch with friends and family. But the net effect is really more social isolation. Same with cell phones. Instant contact with people around the world, yet what do people do when they're face to face in social events? They do this. The exact opposite of socializing.

So we're already experiencing what it's like to have more convenience added to our lives. It actually REMOVES your ability to live.
I think I'd have less distractions definitely. I'd definitely get things done quicker without worrying about all the inane bullshit.
